def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)

    kind,p=div
    divcol = g[p][0] if kind=='h' else g[0][p]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (divcol,bgc)]
    oc=g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    for i,j in cells: g[i][j]=bgc   # clear object
    if kind=='v':
        side = 1 if cells[0][1]>p else -1
        near = min(j for i,j in cells) if side==1 else max(j for i,j in cells)
        shift = (near-1-p)*side if side==1 else (p-near-1)*side
        # distance so object becomes adjacent to divider
        dist = (near-1-p) if side==1 else (p-1-near)

            cells=[(i,j+side*dist) for i,j in cells]

        far = max(j for i,j in cells) if side==1 else min(j for i,j in cells)
        lj = far+side
        for i in range(h): g[i][lj]=8

        for j in range(w): g[li][j]=8
        for i,j in cells: g[i][j]=oc
